_instructions.how_to_use: Fill in the raw values. Leave anything marked CALCULATED as null or omit it — Claude computes it from your raw numbers. Write hypotheses/insights rough; Claude polishes wording. For tags, just give platform + runtime_days (facts); Claude adds the rest.
calculated_fields_claude_fills: each arm's rate %, uplift/delta vs control, order delta
each test's net_revenue_impact_per_month (from winner order delta + runtime_days + aov)

status_values.ship: ✓ winner, shipping (green). Set ship_variant to the arm that won.
status_values.performing: ✓ performing / healthy (green) — for observational funnels, not a win/lose test.

_instructions.notes: AOV is in ৳ (BDT). runtime_days drives the monthly projection. is_control marks the baseline arm. winner:true marks the shipped arm in the results table (star).

special_sections._comment: OPTIONAL observational block like May's 'Buy-now button'. Delete this whole object if not needed this month.
special_sections.intro: One-line rough description of what this section shows — Claude polishes.
